body: I glance around, noticing the silence in the room, the stillness, the air thick with anticipation. My gaze sweeps across the space, searching for a face I might recognize or a clue about the identity of the voice. As I take in the surroundings, I think about the anger rising within me, the indignation that fuels my desire to confront. I feel the urge to be proactive, to set things right, to take control.
